superseded_reason: EVERY NUMBER BELOW IS CONTAMINATED AND NONE OF IT MAY BE PROMOTED INTO POLICY. The run that produced it valued an in-kind leg with no row price at quantity x market_value_settled_unsettled -- a WHOLE POSITION'S MARKET VALUE used as a UNIT PRICE. Measured on dim_position date=2026-09-25 (106,578 comparable rows of 106,835): the multiplier market_value_settled_unsettled / closing_price has median 71.0x, p90 718.0x, max 5,353,077.5x. 32,587 of 43,447 in-kind legs over the 561-partition history carry no positive row price and so reached that fallback. The observed tails recorded below as 'the data's own distribution' (tolerance max 214.58, large_flow max 217.996, observed_r_p001 -0.912047) are therefore instrument artifacts, not properties of the custodian's data.
root_cause: sources.json declares inkind_price_column ('price', the TRANSACTION row's price) and position_value_column ('market_value_settled_unsettled') but never declares price_column. FlowCache._closes() reads src.get('price_column') and falls back to position_value_column when it is absent, so the fallback was dimensionally invalid from the first run that used it.
the_real_unit_price: dim_position carries closing_price. VALIDATED rather than assumed: quantity_settled_unsettled x closing_price reproduces market_value_settled_unsettled within 1 basis point on 106,307 of 106,578 comparable rows on date=2026-09-25.
found_by: a methodology review Andrew commissioned (REVIEW.md finding F01), confirmed at bytes by this seat against the producer and the live positions schema.

ORIGINAL_CONTENT_BELOW_UNCHANGED.tolerance_basis: p99 of |r_t - (holdings_price_return + income_return)| over 1098 reconciled account-days
ORIGINAL_CONTENT_BELOW_UNCHANGED.plausibility_band_basis: the data's own p0.1 (-0.912047) or p99.9 (0.044193) reaches the PRD's default band, so the band is REPORTED against the default rather than silently widened -- a widening is the CTO's, not this cell's.
ORIGINAL_CONTENT_BELOW_UNCHANGED.large_flow_share_recommendation_basis: p90 of |F_t| / V_(t-1) over the 13 account-days that actually carry a flow, not over all 1098. The unconditional p99 the order names is 1e-06 -- a percentile of zeros. NOT SUBSTITUTED HERE: `large_flow_share` still carries the order's own rule and this is a recommendation beside it, because changing which population a served threshold is measured over is the issuer's call.
